responsibility: Is the central implementation file for the rs6000 backend, providing the bulk of PowerPC target hooks and shared code-generation policy outside specialized call/prologue/string/pass files. It owns core target state such as builtin type/declaration tables, register and mode legality data, ABI and option-dependent behavior, builtin name remapping, invalid conversion diagnostics for Power-specific opaque vector-pair/quad types, scheduler and loop hooks, PIC/jumptable and constant-emission helpers, and many other targetm callbacks that connect GCC’s generic middle end to rs6000-specific RTL expansion, legality, and final code-generation decisions.
same_name_distinction: Within the core rs6000 same-name set, this is the compiled backend implementation file: it defines target hook functions, global target state, builtin remapping/diagnostics, and code-generation helpers, whereas rs6000.h supplies macros/types/declarations, rs6000.md describes RTL instruction patterns and attributes, and rs6000.opt declares command-line options and target variables.
